description: This Java class 'UtilFormatOut' provides various utility functions for formatting numbers, currencies, dates, and strings, mainly for use in JSPs within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilFormatOut
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for formatting numbers, dates, strings, and encoding for web and XML contexts.

methods.name: safeToString
methods.description: Converts an object to string safely, returning empty string if null.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a Double number according to specified format type and locale.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Overloaded method to format a BigDecimal number.

methods.name: formatPrice
methods.description: Deprecated method to format a Double or BigDecimal as price.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a double or BigDecimal as currency string based on ISO code and locale.

methods.name: formatDecimalNumber
methods.description: Formats a number according to a pattern and locale.

methods.name: formatSpelledOutAmount
methods.description: Formats a number into spelled-out words based on locale.

methods.name: formatAmount
methods.description: Locale-aware formatting of a double amount.

methods.name: formatPercentage
methods.description: Formats a percentage value from Double or BigDecimal.

methods.name: formatPercentageRate
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal as a percentage rate, optionally negated.

methods.name: formatQuantity
methods.description: Formats quantity from various numeric types into string.

methods.name: formatPaddedNumber
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zeros to specified length.

methods.name: formatPaddingRemove
methods.description: Removes leading zeros from a string.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a SQL Timestamp into a date-time string.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date into a date string with optional format, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a Date into a date-time string with optional format, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: makeString
methods.description: Converts an object to string, encoding byte arrays as Base64, or returns empty string if null.

methods.name: checkNull
methods.description: Returns the string if not null, otherwise empty string; overloaded for multiple args.

methods.name: ifNotEmpty
methods.description: Returns pre + base + post if base is not empty.

methods.name: checkEmpty
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty string among arguments.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a URL query string, replacing certain characters.

methods.name: encodeQueryValue
methods.description: Encodes a URL query value, replacing special characters.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: decodeQueryValue
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded query value back to plain string.

methods.name: encodeXmlValue
methods.description: Encodes special characters in XML.

methods.name: padString
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length with a character, either at end or start.

methods.name: makeSqlSafe
methods.description: Escapes single quotes for SQL safety.

methods.name: formatPrintableCreditCard
methods.description: Masks all but last four digits of a credit card number.
